## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Termoli, Italy. It starts at Piazza Duomo, 1.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Venture to the depths beneath the cathedral and the Bishop’s Palace, and see excavations that have been brought to light after being hidden for centuries. After going five meters below ground, you’ll see finds from the Middle Ages, a 10th-century necropolis, and an ancient cistern.
>
> Get ready for unexpected stories and surprising details!
